name: expiry-sweep-bounded-pause
title: F3 expiry sweeps: bounded pause, zero allocation under locks
description: Structural finding F3 of 09-29-tcp-udp-path-structural-perf: the four expiry sweep sites (FlowTable, TcpRedirectTable, UdpProxyCoordinator, UdpAssociationPool) each enumerate everything under their gate, so a 65,536-entry flow-table sweep blocks a resolve for up to 40 ms against the research's 0.5 ms target, and four sites allocate their retirement sets under the lock. Replace them with bounded-pause, allocation-free expiry driven by bucketed activity time.
creator: qmazon
